infrastructure.export.export_writer_adap.owner: Arrow: _write_xlsx_file -> write_arrow_xlsx -> new_xlsx_workbook/save_xlsx_workbook owns one openpyxl Workbook save; non-Arrow: _write_duck_xlsx owns a pandas ExcelWriter context
infrastructure.export.export_writer_adap.closer: Arrow save_xlsx_workbook invokes workbook.close in finally and removes its temporary path; the non-Arrow pandas ExcelWriter context owns its writer close. openpyxl archive/error cleanup still requires independent runtime observation.
infrastructure.export.export_writer_adap.shutdown_contract: pa.Table dispatches to write_arrow_xlsx, creates openpyxl.Workbook and calls save_xlsx_workbook for temporary save/replace with workbook.close in finally. Non-Arrow objects dispatch to _write_duck_xlsx and its pandas ExcelWriter context. Static source ownership only; runtime shutdown/leak qualification remains NOT_RUN_12553.
infrastructure.export.export_writer_adap.production_entrypoint: bioetl export --format xlsx -> ExportWriterAdapter -> _write_xlsx_file -> write_arrow_xlsx (pa.Table) or _write_duck_xlsx (non-Arrow)

iuphar.bioetl.infrastructure.storage.tar.closer: Exiting with path.open('a+b') closes the descriptor and releases the kernel lock; _lock does not call an explicit unlock.
iuphar.bioetl.infrastructure.storage.tar.shutdown_contract: _lock acquires a nonblocking msvcrt.locking or fcntl.flock lock and yields inside the file context. Descriptor closure on context exit, including exception exit, releases the lock; a leftover path is not a live owner. Static source mechanism only; runtime qualification remains NOT_RUN_12553.
